card.name: Section names in cross-references
card.fires_on: The first piece of a section title (Dosage, Adverse, Overdosage, Contraindications) inside a bracketed cross-reference such as [see ...]. It also fires on 'and' or a closing quote within these titles.

modes.label: Start of section title
modes.description: The first part of a section name right after 'see', 'and' or a comma in a bracketed cross-reference.

modes.label: Inside a title
modes.description: A linking word or closing quote within a section title or cross-reference.
modes.example: Refer to Dosage Interruptions<< and>> Modifications below
